title: Clock and Lantern
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Wendell Eriksen, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
